## calendars-client: no slot for spec /set args (sendSchedulingMessages, onSuccessSetIsDefault); contacts types the same arg as Value
Crates: jmap-calendars-client, jmap-contacts-client
Evidence: 1) calendar_event_set (crate-jmap-calendars-client/src/methods/event.rs:165) takes only (create, update, destroy, if_in_state): no params argument and no extra map. calendars-33 L1591 defines the CalendarEvent/set argument `sendSchedulingMessages: Boolean`, and the server already honours it (crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/backend.rs:80-82, CalendarEventSetArgs). 2) participant_identity_set (participant_identity.rs:123) also has no params argument, but calendars-33 L699 defines ParticipantIdentity/set `onSuccessSetIsDefault: Id|null`, and the server reads it (crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/participant_identity.rs:119). 3) CalendarSetParams (methods/mod.rs:122) is exhaustive and has no on_success_set_is_default, although calendars-33 L1049 defines it and calendar.rs:131 in the server handles it. 4) The sibling AddressBookSetParams.on_success_set_is_default (crate-jmap-contacts-client/src/methods/mod.rs:45) carries the same RFC 9610 §2.3 Id|null argument as `Option<serde_json::Value>`. So the same concept has three shapes: missing, untyped, or not reachable at all. Canonical mail follows the pattern `xxx_set(..., params: Option<XxxSetParams>)` with typed fields (MailboxSetParams, EmailSubmissionSetParams).
Why breaking later: Adding a parameter to calendar_event_set or participant_identity_set changes their public signatures. Adding a named field to the exhaustive CalendarSetParams breaks struct-literal construction. Retyping the contacts field from Value breaks callers. Today a client cannot ask the server to send iTIP scheduling messages at all.
Fix: Add CalendarEventSetParams { send_scheduling_messages: Option<bool>, extra } and ParticipantIdentitySetParams { on_success_set_is_default, extra }, each passed as a trailing `params: Option<...>` like mailbox_set. Add on_success_set_is_default to CalendarSetParams. Use a single typed shape for onSuccessSetIsDefault in both calendars and contacts: an Id-or-'#creationId' string type, not serde_json::Value.
Size: M
